title: The Gallagher Brothers Finally Sat Down Together — and Cameras Were Rolling!
summary: Imagine two brothers who are rock stars. They haven't really talked to each other in more than 25 years. Now imagine they agree to sit on a couch together — with cameras rolling! That's exactly what happened with Liam and Noel Gallagher from the band Oasis. A new documentary about their 2025 reunion tour will show their first joint interview in decades. The film doesn't have a title yet, but it's coming to IMAX theaters on September 11, and later to Disney+. The director, Steven Knight, says it captures the spirit of a global moment and the wit of two exceptional people. He also wanted to tell the story of the fans — people whose lives were changed by songs like "Wonderwall." The movie will have rehearsal clips, backstage moments, and concert footage from the tour that went all over the UK, the U.S., and the world. Liam and Noel are famous for being hilarious in interviews — and for arguing a lot. Their 1995 interview "Wibbling Rivalry" is legendary. So fans are super excited to see them together again, maybe even smiling! As Knight said, in a time of division, music can give us hope. And who doesn't need a little hope — and a lot of rock 'n' roll?
why_it_matters: It shows that even when people have big fights, they can still come together to create something joyful — just like you might with a friend or sibling.

Some people worry that the brothers might start arguing again and that the reunion won't last.
